topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints significantly impact payload power allocation, necessitating prioritization between immediate and time-tagged services. Immediate services require more immediate power but consume less storage, potentially degrading overall capacity. Time-tagged services can be scheduled to optimize power use, reducing wastage. Cognitive Radio (CR) and Hybrid Beamforming enable adaptive resource allocation based on real-time traffic patterns and channel conditions, improving efficiency while minimizing performance penalties. Machine Learning (ML) can further enhance CR's capabilities by learning from historical data and adapting to changing traffic patterns.
reference_context: On-board storage constraints limit payload power allocation due to memory capacity limitations, necessitating prioritization between immediate and time-tagged services.
